verdict.rationale: Unity provides an official MCP server and Assistant feature that lets users create assets, automate workflows, analyze performance, and perform project actions using natural-language prompts, connecting LLM agents like Claude Code/Cursor to the Editor. However, this is a bolt-on AI Assistant/MCP layer rather than the whole product being natively operable via NL, and no independent/hands-on evidence corroborates real-world reliability of these natural-language commands. Missing for 10: independent verification of the Assistant's NL command reliability, breadth of coverage across all Editor operations, and confirmation it isn't limited/experimental.
